block.isekai_mahou.runic_pedestal.toolti: Casts the spell of a Spell Scroll by itself, every N seconds.
Uses mana from Mana Batteries up to 8 blocks away.
Click with the scroll to insert it; click empty-handed to configure; sneak to see its status.
block.isekai_mahou.mana_battery.tooltip1: Stores mana for pedestals. Sneak + click with an empty hand to pour your mana into it.
block.isekai_mahou.mana_battery.tooltip2: Keeps its charge when broken. Comparators read the level.
block.isekai_mahou.mana_condenser.toolti: Burns mana crystals, essences, amethyst, lapis and redstone.
Sends the mana to Batteries up to 8 blocks away. Hoppers can insert fuel.
block.isekai_mahou.arcane_collector.tool: Pulls loose items within 6 blocks into 27 slots.
Hoppers pull items out. A redstone signal pauses it. Pedestals with Collect send items to it.
glyph.isekai_mahou.harvest_replant.desc: Harvests ripe crops in the area and replants them with a seed from the harvest. Sometimes makes sprouts grow. Fortune: harvests with Fortune III.
glyph.isekai_mahou.collect_items.desc: Pulls loose items and XP orbs in the area to you. On a Runic Pedestal, sends the items to the nearest Arcane Collector.
glyph.isekai_mahou.shear.desc: Shears the animals in the area and takes honeycomb from full beehives without angering the bees. Leaves mooshrooms and snow golems alone.
glyph.isekai_mahou.breed.desc: Feeds pairs of adult animals in the area with the right food from your inventory (on a pedestal: from chests touching it). Stops at 24 animals of a kind.
glyph.isekai_mahou.till.desc: Tills grass and dirt in the area like a hoe and leaves the farmland well watered.
glyph.isekai_mahou.sow.desc: Plants seeds from your inventory (on a pedestal: from chests touching it) on empty farmland in the area, following the rows.
glyph.isekai_mahou.call_rain.desc: Makes it rain in the world for 5 minutes. The creature hit gets soaked and its fire goes out.
glyph.isekai_mahou.clear_sky.desc: Drives rain and storms away for 5 minutes.
glyph.isekai_mahou.call_thunder.desc: Summons a 5-minute thunderstorm. The creature hit is struck by real lightning (charges creepers!).
glyph.isekai_mahou.smelt_items.desc: Cooks the loose items in the area with furnace recipes (up to 32 at a time) and drops the XP. The creature hit catches fire.
message.isekai_mahou.automation.no_playe: You have no mana to transfer.
message.isekai_mahou.automation.pedestal: Runic Pedestals are disabled on this server.
Limit of %s Runic Pedestals in this chunk.
message.isekai_mahou.automation.no_food: No suitable food for these animals.
message.isekai_mahou.automation.too_crow: There are already %s animals of this kind nearby.
message.isekai_mahou.automation.weather_: The sky here does not hear your call.
☔ The rain answers your call (%s min).
gui.isekai_mahou.pedestal.interval.toolt: Time between casts (1 to 60 s). Shift: ±10 s.
gui.isekai_mahou.pedestal.direction.tool: Where the spell is cast. Downwards it hits the pedestal's own top and works around it (great for crops); with Aim Y −2 or lower it comes out below it. Right-click: previous option.
gui.isekai_mahou.pedestal.offset.tooltip: Moves the point where the spell is born (−8 to +8 blocks from the top of the pedestal).
gui.isekai_mahou.pedestal.redstone.toolt: Always · Powered · Unpowered · Pulse (1 cast per pulse). Right click: previous option.
gui.isekai_mahou.pedestal.test.tooltip: Casts now (uses mana) and shows the aim.
gui.isekai_mahou.pedestal.mana.tooltip: Total mana in Batteries up to %s blocks away. The gold mark is the cost of 1 cast.
gui.isekai_mahou.pedestal.hint.active: Casting on its own. All good!
gui.isekai_mahou.pedestal.hint.empty_scr: Write a spell in the Grimoire.
gui.isekai_mahou.pedestal.hint.invalid: The scroll's recipe has an error.
gui.isekai_mahou.pedestal.hint.no_owner: Open its screen to become the owner.
